qc/runs/hireops-live-desk-2026-10-02-r1/manifest.json (input hashes for the three brief files)
evidence: Hashes: sha256 of frozen instruction.md (54c155e2...), hireops_rules.md (bf9944d9...) and integration.md (1adabb9e...) recomputed and equal to manifest.json inputs. Spelling: manual full read of all three files (no dictionary tool was run); no misspelling found. A doubled-word regex and a duplicate-line check found nothing beyond repeated table header rows in the two vesting tables (hireops_rules.md:311-313 and 322-324). Contamination: grep -rniE 'CHANGE[_-]?ME|TODO|FIXME|XXX|<placeholder>|lorem ipsum|TBD|NOTE:|author|reviewer|C:\\|F:/|/Users/|/home/|.qc|golden|oracle' over instruction.md and environment/instructions hits only the words 'authoritative', 'authority' and 'authorization' in hireops_rules.md; no placeholder, no host-machine path, no author aside. The template placeholders ('CHANGE_ME: write the task prompt...' in template instruction.md and notes.md) are not present in the task. The only paths in the brief are container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /app/app.db, /app/server.js). Contradiction cross-checks, all consistent: (a) one clock value, 2026-08-01T00:00:00Z at hireops_rules.md:60, equal to seed reference_moment, and instruction.md:13 says 'the one stored reference moment'; (b) one account list, the seven emails at instruction.md:19 match the seven seed users and roles one for one, with Band I/II/III matching authority_tier 1/2/3 as hireops_rules.md:163-164 maps them; (c) one password, Hireops!2026, at instruction.md:19 and hireops_rules.md:25 and 359; (d) one seed path, /assets/seed_data.json, at instruction.md:15 and integration.md:7; (e) start command, port 3000, health path and /app/app.db with DB_PATH agree between instruction.md:15 and integration.md:5-10; (f) 'between two and four' at instruction.md:7 matches 'two through four' at hireops_rules.md:424 and 505; (g) 'fifteen seconds' at instruction.md:9 matches '15 seconds' at hireops_rules.md:519-520; (h) the 'section 12' pointer at instruction.md:13 resolves to hireops_rules.md:484; (i) vesting tables at hireops_rules.md:311-327 match the seed constants (4000/500/24 and 2000/400/32); (j) 'One row in the export sits at DRAFT' at hireops_rules.md:215 is true, seed offer OFF-301; (k) no dashboard at instruction.md:5 matches hireops_rules.md:408. Non-blocking observations, none of which reaches a real spelling error or a pasted-in contaminant: (1) spelling variant is mixed, British in instruction.md ('honour', 'honouring' line 15, 'behaviour' line 13) and American in integration.md:7 ('honoring') and hireops_rules.md:418 ('Honor'), :132 ('amortizes'), :481 ('authorization'); integration.md is the template's own wording, so this is a house-style seam, not an error. (2) hireops_rules.md:401 says 'Approving mints three things' while :12-13 and :219-227 list four (budget commitment, equity grant, referral accrual, signing remittance); section 9 covers the commitment movements separately at :397-399, so the required behaviour is the same, but the count reads inconsistently. (3) hireops_rules.md:37-38 says 'the auditor changes nothing at all' and the next sentence says 'Other signed-in roles may also open requisitions'; the second is optional, so no builder is forced into a conflict, but the wording is loose. (4) hireops_rules.md:4 'They're relocated, topic by topic, from our own working notes' is unusual phrasing that reads slightly like an authoring-process remark; it is in voice and names no process artefact. (5) hireops_rules.md:83 requires amounts to be integers 'in their stored units' while :511-512 treats 'money with more than two decimal places' as the malformed case, which implies dollar entry in the editor; this is an entry-unit ambiguity for check 6 rather than a contradiction under check 3. No run evidence is needed or used for this row; raw-evidence-index.json carries the same input_sha256 and was not otherwise relied on.
suggested_fix: Optional wording tidy only, in a future candidate if the files are being edited anyway: change hireops_rules.md:401 to name the items without the count 'three', and scope hireops_rules.md:38 to 'Other signed-in roles except the auditor'.
